metadata.description: Red tiles form a prancing horse in profile with mane and flowing tail. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Offset garden courts surround the motif, with slalom gates along the lower route. 5 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 7 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
